info.title: Test app on Windows 11 with three monitors

metadata.displayText:
test app in this pc 
windows 11 and 3 mointors

messages.text:
test app in this pc 
windows 11 and 3 mointors

content.text:
The user wants me to test the app on this PC (Windows 11, 3 monitors). Let me start by exploring the project structure and building/running the app.

Let me plan: 
1. Check the environment — display setup, monitors.
2. Build the app.
3. Launch it.
4. Verify overlay placement on each monitor, taskbar detection.
5. Check settings.json, logs.
6. Report findings.

Let me start.
I'll test the app on this machine. Let me start by checking the display setup and project state.

input.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController | Select-Object Name, CurrentHorizontalResolution, CurrentVerticalResolution | Format-Table -AutoSize; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; [System.Windows.Forms.Screen]::AllScreens | ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{ Device=$_.DeviceName; Primary=$_.Primary; Bounds=$_.Bounds; Working=$_.WorkingArea } } | Format-Table -AutoSize

Get-ChildItem -Force | Select-Object Mode, Length, Name | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output "---TASKBAR---"; Get-Process explorer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, StartTime | Format-Table -AutoSize
